neighbours.label: ' world'/' worlds' in the figurative sense of a realm or domain ('another world', 'the wonderful world of X', 'secret worlds'), not the globe
fire: When the music starts, she drifts away into another world.
This week we explore the fascinating world of deep-sea fish.
Stepping through the old gate felt like entering a different world.
The little bookshop opened up whole new worlds for the boy.
My uncle introduced me to the strange world of stamp collecting.
With the headphones on, he was lost in another world.
The documentary takes viewers inside the hidden world of ants.
For the children, the attic was a secret world of its own.
quiet: When the music starts, she drifts away into another room.
This week we ship the fascinating fish all over the world.
Stepping through the old gate felt like entering a different garden.
The little bookshop sold maps from every corner of the world.
My uncle introduced me to the strange hobby of stamp collecting.
With the headphones on, he sailed around the world alone.
The documentary takes viewers inside the hidden nest of ants.
For the children, the attic was a secret hideout of their own.

notes: Probe: 'another world entirely' 0.74, 'wonderful world of amateur radio' 0.46; 'around the world' 0.04, 'another country' 0.04, 'wonderful hobby of' 0.12, Heaven 0.12. Near misses use the geographic 'world' or swap the word.
